verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the trial page's claim that users can "Cancel and remove your data at any time". That is a first-party deletion statement, but it is a single thin mention tied to trial cancellation. Encryption, permissions and audit logs are adjacent security controls, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, granular per-record or per-dataset deletion, documented deletion process and timelines, deletion controls for AI agent data or context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Cancel and remove your data at any time if you don't love what you see.
